term: paired and unpaired S4 collapse pockets
definition: pockets paired enumerates root, left, right, twin. Root accesses all four; left accesses only itself. Right and twin access themselves and, exactly when paired=true, each other. Thus there are no cross-edges between the left singleton and the right-side terminal component(s). Atom false holds only at left. Atom true holds only at twin when paired=false. These mathematical labels, edges and valuations are stipulated, with no metaphysical or historical interpretation.
note: Mathematical S4 experiment requested in #265, using the shared #261 semantics. Historical adoption or metaphysical possibility would need a separate pinned and interpreted source claim.
